title: 第十五章 白袖道士第十六章 棺中锁魂
slug: 坟头开铺我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
lines: 白袖道士天亮前到的。
他坐一顶青布小轿，两个道童提灯引路。轿帘一掀，先露出一截白袖。袖口银线暗绣云纹，灯下一闪，像一只半睁的眼。
风一吹，那银线像活物似的闪了一下。
阿青只看了一眼，纸身便僵住。
沈清萝察觉不对。
“阿青？”
阿青没有答。
她盯着那道袖纹，声音轻得像被风吹散。
“这个纹……我见过。”
她顿了顿，纸边开始发抖。
“我死那天见过。”
沈清萝眼神沉下来。
阿青胆子素来不小，敢笑谢无咎，敢跟糖糕拌嘴，也敢趴在坟头听死人哭。这会儿只瞥一眼就慌成这样，那纹路就绝不是寻常的眼熟了。
沈清萝抬手轻轻碰了碰引魂铃。
“先别想。”
阿青缩回去一点，纸身仍抖。
白袖道士已经走到梁家人面前。
梁二叔亲自迎上去，像终于等到救命的人。
“方道长，您可来了。”
道士方怀仁扫过院中众人，视线落到沈清萝身上。
他看见她腰间的铜钱、布包、引魂铃，最后在她袖口停了一瞬。
双生契平时藏在皮下，若不细看，看不出来。
谢无咎往前挪了半步。
不多。
刚好挡住方怀仁的视线。
沈清萝余光看见，没说话。
方怀仁冷笑：“这就是你们请来的守墓人？”
梁二叔叹气：“沈姑娘年轻，做事急了些。祖坟闹煞，还是得请正法。”
方怀仁看向沈清萝。
“一个散修守墓人，也敢在祖坟前论正法？”
沈清萝从布包里取出玄司文书。
“法牒呢？”
方怀仁一顿。
沈清萝把文书往供桌上一放。
“我接的是墓籍堂登记的梁家祖坟哭煞案。你要接手，出示法牒，或者出示玄司转办文书。”
方怀仁脸色不变。
“白道除祟，何须向你自证？”
“没有牒，你这身白袍，和我院里晾的孝布一个用处。”
方怀仁的脸一下冷了。
这一句，把他那身白道清名和死人孝布摆到了一处。
梁家族人里有人没忍住抬头看了他一眼。正派最怕的不是被骂狠，是被骂得像那么回事。
阿青明明还在发抖，听见这句，还是没忍住抬了下头。
糖糕蹲在墙头，幽幽道：“孝布还能卖钱。”
方怀仁眼底冷意一闪。
content_en:
The white-sleeved Taoist priest arrived before dawn.
He sat in a small sedan chair made of green cloth, and two Taoist boys carried lanterns to guide the way. When the sedan curtain is lifted, a white sleeve is exposed first. The cuffs are darkly embroidered with cloud patterns in silver thread, and they look like a half-open eye under the light.
When the wind blew, the silver thread flashed like a living thing.
Ah Qing only glanced at it, and then his body froze.
Shen Qingluo noticed something was wrong.
"Aqing?"
Ah Qing didn't answer.
She stared at the sleeve lines and her voice was as soft as if it was blown away by the wind.
"This pattern... I've seen it before."
She paused, and the edge of the paper began to tremble.
"I saw it the day I died."
Shen Qingluo's eyes darkened.
Ah Qing has always been very courageous. He dares to smile and thank Wu Jiu, dare to argue with Tang Gao, and dare to lie on the grave and listen to the dead cry. At this moment, I only glanced at it and became so panicked. The lines were definitely not familiar.
Shen Qingluo raised her hand and gently touched the soul-inducing bell.
"Don't think about it yet."
Ah Qing shrank back a little, but the paper was still shaking.
The white-sleeved Taoist priest had already walked up to the Liang family.
Second Uncle Liang went to meet him personally, as if he was finally waiting for help.
"Director Fang, you are here."
Taoist priest Fang Huairen glanced at the people in the courtyard and his eyes fell on Shen Qingluo.
He saw the copper coins, cloth bag, and soul-inducing bell around her waist, and finally stopped for a moment on her sleeves.
The twin contract is usually hidden under the skin and cannot be seen unless you look closely.
Xie Wujiu moved forward half a step.
not much.
Just blocking Fang Huairen's sight.
Shen Qingluo saw it from the corner of her eye and said nothing.
Fang Huairen sneered: "Is this the tombkeeper you invited?"
Second Uncle Liang sighed: "Miss Shen is young and has been a little hasty in doing things. If there is trouble in the ancestral grave, we still need to seek justice."
Fang Huairen looked at Shen Qingluo.
"How dare a casual cultivator and gravekeeper discuss Dharma in front of his ancestor's grave?"
Shen Qingluo took out Xuansi's documents from the cloth bag.
"Where's the ultimatum?"
Fang Huairen was stunned.
Shen Qingluo put the documents on the altar table.
"I'm taking over the case of the Liang family's ancestral tombs registered in the tomb hall. If you take over the case, you need to show the legal certificate or the Xuansi transfer document."
Fang Huairen's expression did not change.
"If I can get rid of evil spirits in vain, why should I prove myself to you?"
"There is no ultimatum. This white robe of yours has the same use as the mourning cloth hanging in my courtyard."
Fang Huairen's face turned cold.
This sentence put his white clothes and the mourning cloth in one place.
Someone in the Liang family couldn't help but look up at him. What a decent person fears most is not being scolded harshly, but being scolded badly.
Ah Qing was obviously still trembling, but after hearing this, he couldn't help but raise his head.
Tanggao squatted on the wall and said quietly: "Xiaobu can still make money."
Fang Huairen's eyes flashed coldly.
